name: Page Skeleton (Both Root Shapes)
description: Two real page-root shapes exist in the codebase. Use bareLayoutArrayVariant for a plain form/detail page (most *-general-sect.json files). Use fullPageObjectVariant when the page needs wheninit/whenload seeding, a custom appbar, or a report/dashboard shape (wf-print.json, ppr-ppr-general-sect.json, dashboards).

bareLayoutArrayVariant.description: Root is a JSON array containing one top-level 'sect' container. Do not recreate the sidebar/header/nav shell — the PWA shell already provides it; this array is only the page content area.

fullPageObjectVariant.description: Root is a JSON object with title/wheninit/whenload/style/appbar/layout keys. wheninit seeds default/lookup datasets before render; whenload runs procedure calls needing a live session (e.g. GetSessionId). layout holds the same 'sect' array as the bare variant.
